caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a high, flat backrest that has angled top corners and a straight, horizontal top edge. The chair is colored in shades of reddish-brown, showing the wood grain texture. The seat is rectangular with beveled or chamfered front corners, and the front edge has a decorative profile. The chair has four turned legs: the front two legs are intricately spiraled and rounded, while the back legs are less detailed but still turned. The chair is shown on a plain, beige background. In the lower right corner, there is a smaller schematic outline of the chair in a simple black line drawing, reflecting the shape and leg positions seen in the main colored illustration.
